text: Debugging is an important skill for any programmer. When your code does not work, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem is and what causes it. Many debugging tools can help you, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution. A systematic approach is also useful: check your code carefully, test one part at a time, and make changes slowly. Logging is another helpful method. By adding log messages, you can see what your program is doing and find errors more easily. With practice, debugging becomes faster and less stressful.
